misalignments.reason: FI-28E3D7762B5F tests historical-evidence authorization, which belongs to O-6D6621FF13D9, not the append-only evidence obligation O-485C68C1E1F1.
Assertion A-B148C5C61A99-repository-relative-paths-unchanged is outside O-A701CC4D17A9's S1-selector obligation and lacks a corresponding bound RED intent.
Its oracle additionally requires independent S16 production-entry verification; O-0E0AF408E93B only constrains listed fixture roles. S16 behavior verification is separately covered by O-D5C63B1A66D4.
Its expected result additionally requires append-only repair evidence, which is separately O-485C68C1E1F1; O-59825F983D6A is limited to historical-byte preservation.
